title: Scale ball gold labels 22 -> 60 with occlusion states
whatWasBuilt: 38 new visually-verified ball gold labels across 6 bundles (5 wavea-* + wm-volley-02), each in a new append-only annotation file bundles/<id>/annotation/devin-visual-v2-waveC.json; no existing annotation file was modified.

Minimal schema extension: optional BallFrameLabel.occlusionState ('observed' | 'entering_occlusion' | 'occluded' | 'reacquired') + validation in packages/swing-lab/src/annotationSchema.ts. Existing visibility semantics unchanged: occlusionState=occluded requires visibility=occluded and no point; the other three require visibility=visible with a normalized point. Field is optional, so all 22 pre-existing labels remain valid unchanged.

datasets/ball-bench/ball-bench.json registry updated append-only: 5 new development cases (wavea recording-clock) + note documenting the wm-volley-02 clip-clock extension file and the 22 -> 60 total; coverageGaps rewritten to reflect actual coverage.

occlusionSequences: paddle occlusion: wavea-944403-smash 4821ms entering, 4838-4855ms occluded (contact happens while hidden; no point invented), 4872ms reacquired
body occlusion: wavea-faead-rally 13417ms entering, 13458-13583ms occluded behind near player's torso, 13625ms reacquired at hip edge

provenance.method: Frames decoded by frame index at exact container fps (ffmpeg full-decode, no -ss seeking); tMs = round(n*1000/fps). Recording clock for wavea-* (matching event-bounds-wave-a.json), clip clock for wm-volley-02. Centers = color+motion blob centroids on the decoded frame, each visually verified in zoomed grid crops before acceptance; detector candidates that failed visual verification were discarded. radiusNorm = ball pixel radius / 1080.
sources: wm-volley-02 labeled from the committed bundles/wm-volley-02/clip.mp4
provenance.heldOutDiscipline: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not opened, labeled, or iterated against.

honestNegatives: No net-crossing occlusion sequence was found and labeled: the inspected 944403-dink net pass keeps the ball fully visible over the net band, so occlusion coverage is paddle- and body-occlusion only.
The target said >=50 total including the requested states; the net-crossing priority slice specifically is still uncovered.
wavea-faead-rally 13625ms reacquired label has no radiusNorm (ball only partially visible at the hip edge; fragment radius would be a guess).
wm-volley-02 6880ms is labeled uncertain (ball indistinguishable against crowd), contributing no scoreable point.

The 5 new ball-bench cases are NOT scoreable by runBallBench yet: their runDirs (runs-wave-a/*) are event-replay runs without ball debug artifacts, and canonical run regeneration is macOS-only. runBallBench skips cases with missing debug artifacts, so denominators of existing results are unchanged.
wavea-marne-dig radii (4.5-6px at 1080p outdoors) are approximate; the ball image is small and soft.
remainsBlocked: Scoring the new wavea labels through pnpm ball:bench requires ball debug artifacts from the macOS cascade (pnpm lab:regen / lab:analyze on the source recordings) - cannot run on this Linux box.
Net-crossing occlusion labels need footage where the ball actually passes behind the net tape/post; none of the inspected committed development windows contains one.
